purpose: Identify which FEM organ and contact settings precede the first invalid state on the RTX 4090.

localized_element.interpretation: The inverted cell is not among the smallest-volume cecum tets and none of its nodes is pinned. Its rest centroid is within the jaw/tool reach at the failure pose.

localized_element_mesh_quality_audit.method: Circumsphere radius divided by shortest edge, computed from the rest tetrahedron; ranks compared across all 14,914 cecum tets.
localized_element_mesh_quality_audit.interpretation: This scalar quality measure does not flag the inverted cell as an extreme sliver. It cannot exclude other discretization or mesh-to-tool collision deficiencies and is not a general mesh-quality certification.

failure_tick_contact_trace.interpretation: The complete four-node vertex set of the most inverted cecum tet is present in same-tick left/jaw_left soft-contact records. This is direct contact/inversion co-occurrence and localizes the interaction surface; it does not by itself prove that contact force caused inversion or validate the contact law. The scripted run had no grasp latch and completed zero task stages.

controlled_checks.result: still 2 inverted cecum tets at 6.133 s; minimum signed-volume ratio -0.5581
controlled_checks.conclusion: More local solver iterations alone do not restore positive volume.

controlled_checks.change: physics rate 480 -> 960 Hz, same 8 s scripted action horizon
controlled_checks.result: 3 inverted cecum tets at 6.133 s; minimum signed-volume ratio -0.8408
controlled_checks.conclusion: Smaller nominal time step did not improve this trajectory.

controlled_checks.conclusion: Lowering shape stiffness by 100x gives a small change but does not prevent inversion. These uncalibrated settings are diagnostic and are not promoted as replacements.

instrumentation_changes.per_organ_health: Rollouts now record per-organ inverted-tet counts, minimum signed-volume ratio, and worst local tet index.
instrumentation_changes.failure_contact_trace: Only on invalid FEM steps, record tool-link contact counts, contacted tissue particle IDs by organ, and exact contacts with the worst inverted element's nodes; propagated into the episode scorecard.
instrumentation_changes.shape_contact_configuration: Tool and appendix-shelf ShapeConfig values are now routed from explicit evaluation settings; actual model shape material values were inspected at runtime.
instrumentation_changes.effective_config_sidecar: Each Newton rollout writes newton-backend-config.json with settings and no absolute user paths.

visual_change.renderer: Path tracer now recomputes area-weighted vertex normals from the current deformed surface and interpolates shading normals per hit.
visual_change.validation: 2 geometry-normal unit tests pass; RTX 4090 endoscope render compiled and completed.
visual_change.limitation: The captured CT/FEM surface remains visibly coarse; smooth shading does not add anatomical detail or alter collision geometry.

rejected_or_unverified: A prior soft_contact_kf=0 run changed only the global material, while the instrument ShapeConfig remained fixed; do not interpret it as a tool-friction ablation.
No physical contact stiffness, damping, friction, force sensor, or tissue deformation calibration has been performed.

privacy: Raw videos, rendered images, credentials, and personal information are not included here and remain local.
